name: Fechi Chichi! ~Kyonyuu Sensei no Yuuwaku Jugyou~
original_name: ふぇちちち！～巨乳先生の誘惑授業～
source:
Toru is just an average student. One day, he meets, Nozomi, a Kyonyu classroom teacher. She used to be his home tutor. Yes, he was in love with her.... He is surprised to hear that she lives next door to him! Nozomi loves Toru as well, but she can do nothing.... The one who breaks this deadlock is Satsuki, who is also a teacher and lives with Nozomi. "I like him.... I'll have sex with him...." Her word changes Toru's school life....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
托鲁只是一个普通的学生。有一天，他遇到了Kyonyu的课堂老师Nozomi。她曾经是他的家庭教师。是的，他爱上了她……当他听说她住在他的隔壁时，他感到很惊讶！希美也爱着彻，但她无能为力……打破僵局的是小月，她也是一名教师，与希美住在一起。“我喜欢他……我会和他发生性关系……”她的话改变了Toru的学校生活……

[来自工口游戏商店]
